translations.web: “ ‘Therefore you shall do my statutes, and keep my ordinances and do them; and you shall dwell in the land in safety.
translations.bsb: You are to keep My statutes and carefully observe My judgments, so that you may dwell securely in the land.
translations.kjv: Wherefore ye shall do my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety.
translations.asv: Wherefore ye shall do my statutes, and keep mine ordinances and do them; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety.
